senses.gloss:
उल्व n. (-ल्वं)
 1. The womb.
 2. The embryo.
 3. The membranes investing
the fœtus.
 4. A cavity.
 E. उच् to accumulate, कन् Unādi affix, and
च becomes ल.

उल्वण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
 1. Apparent, evident.
 2. Much, exceeding.
 n. (-णं)
An excess of either of the humors of the body, bile, phlegm or
wind.
 E. उद् up, ल्वी to join, deriv. irr.
